title: Learning Changes the World and Then What Was Learned has Changed: Training and Deploying Neural Networks in the Control Loop
abstract: arXiv:2610.22084v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Neural networks offer critical adaptability for controlling complex systems where nominal modeling proves intractable. However, when offline-trained neural networks are deployed within closed-loop control systems, their actions fundamentally alter the state distribution upon which they were trained. This paper introduces a unified taxonomy to categorize these sequential failure modes: the initial Closed-Loop Identification Error, the deployment-induced Action Error, and the continuous Tracking Error. Through discrete-time sensitivity analysis, this work formalizes how offline-learned parameters locally guarantee a trajectory divergence upon deployment, degrading performance due to local loss geometry. To mitigate this distribution shift, we propose actionable design policies centered on time-scale separated online adaptation. translated_title: 学习改变了世界，而后所学到的也随之改变：在控制回路中训练与部署神经网络
translated_abstract: 神经网络为控制那些标称建模难以处理的复杂系统提供了关键的适应能力。然而，当离线训练的神经网络被部署到闭环控制系统中时，其动作会从根本上改变其训练时所依据的状态分布。本文引入了一个统一的分类体系，对这些顺序发生的失效模式进行归类：初始的闭环辨识误差、部署引发的动作误差以及持续的跟踪误差。通过离散时间敏感性分析，本工作形式化地阐明了离线学习的参数如何在部署时局部地导致轨迹发散，并因局部损失几何结构而造成性能退化。为缓解这种分布偏移，我们提出了以时间尺度分离的在线适应为核心的可操作设计策略。这些机制通过在非线性Duffing振子上的消融实验得到验证，表明……
tldr: 本文提出了一个统一分类体系来刻画离线训练的神经网络部署到闭环控制后因自身动作改变状态分布而引发的三类失效模式，并通过时间尺度分离的在线适应设计策略来缓解该分布偏移问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a unified taxonomy of sequential failure modes arising when offline-trained neural networks deployed in closed-loop control fundamentally alter their training state distribution, and proposes actionable time-scale separated online adaptation policies to mitigate this deployment-induced distribution shift.
